instruction: Help me prepare for lunch in the living room. Move the tomato to the table and set it next to the spoon. Move the toy animal and toy vehicles to the nearby shelves.
First, move the sushi mat and toy vehicle from the dining table to the living room table and place them next to each other. Then, move the shoe from the chair to the bedroom table.
Have a drink. Move the cup and the jug to the dining table. Fill the cup with water from the jug.
Help me tidy up the lounge. Put the plate next to the spoon and fork near the plate.
First, move the plant to the table in the bedroom and then move the cushion and toy animal to the bedroom couch, placing them next to each other.
Help me tidy up the house. Put the toy vehicles on the bedroom table. Put the toy animals inside the other chest. Move the lamp to another living room table.
Move the clock, then the vase, and finally the picture frame to the table in the living room. Then move them to the bench in the living room and place them next to each other.
Move a toy fruit from the table to the bed.
Move the lamp to the bedroom table. Move the statue to the living room shelves.
Help me move a toy fire truck and a toy bee from the bedroom to the kitchen. Also, bring a sushi mat from the kitchen to the bedroom.
